title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #104 · 교복 · 스쿨 수영복 × 하이컷 원피스 · 플랫 흰 캔버스 스니커즈+발목 양말 · USSBBW · 정면 한 손 힙 · 배경 지하철 승강장 · 야미카와
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 20s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut school-swimsuit-style one-piece of ultra-thin matte navy spandex with wide shoulder straps, a white name patch with a small number on the left of her chest, thin white piping along the neckline and the leg openings, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button and the two sides of the spandex fully covering her bust, the leg openings cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the swimsuit shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin and fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the white name patch and the thin white piping crisp against the navy, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: clean white low-top canvas sneakers with white rubber toe caps and white laces tied in neat bows, worn with short white ankle socks folded at the ankle, her feet planted flat on the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a clean brightly lit subway platform with pale tiled walls, a yellow safety line along the platform edge, standard-height train doors and a bench, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
